NULL_hetero_unranked.ranking_machinery: DISABLED: no novelty archive, no novelty gate, no surrogate, no successive halving, no dedup promotion, no cross-round promotion
NULL_hetero_unranked.rationale: every GS-R2 arm ran lane=hetero; this reproduces the search's own sampling measure
NULL_hetero_unranked.viability: evaluate_genome(g, tier='T2')['feasible'] -- frozen hard gates, UNCHANGED

comparator.note: pooled over all five R2 arms, phenotype-deduped, = the T3 hold rate exactly

compute.deviation: the brief specified partition nuc (96/96 idle); this account is refused on nuc despite appearing in its sacctmgr association list, so lu48 -- the partition the GS-R2 campaign itself used -- is the proven path. Recorded as CUSTODY_DEVIATION_PARTITION.
compute.network: NONE. All code and data staged in advance; no outbound connection from any LUNARC node.

decision_rule.GATE_OWNS_DEPLETION: null Wilson95 OVERLAPS the observed interval -> the T2 gate produces the depletion on frozen physics; no allocation or ranking lever can move it; terminal is a proven-structural negative
decision_rule.RANKING_ENRICHES: null Wilson95 lies STRICTLY BELOW the observed interval -> ranking already improves composition; the lever must be sought elsewhere
decision_rule.RANKING_OWNS_DEPLETION: null Wilson95 lies STRICTLY ABOVE the observed interval -> ranking/promotion owns it; lever has a named target

secondary: P(T2-viable | can_check) vs P(T2-viable | not can_check)
odds ratio favouring the checker-free route
F_arch composition of the viable set

falsifiers.impossible_cell: ZERO viable organisms may be both not-can_check and not hierarchical_fibred; any such organism refutes the T2 correctness-route mechanism and voids the attribution
falsifiers.sampling_rate_check: P(can_check) over legal draws must match 1 - (1 - E[n_extras]/12)(1 - 1/9) to within Monte-Carlo error; a mismatch means the sampler is not lane_hetero and the run is void

prohibitions: no T3 key re-drawn, re-selected or consulted to design anything
raising a hold RATE by admitting fewer candidates is selectivity, not edge, and is recorded as a defect
question: is the checker-depletion of the GS-R2 survivor set owned by the T2 admission GATE (frozen physics -> structural) or by the RANKING/PROMOTION machinery (operational -> a lever has a target)?

supersession_rule: any post-freeze change to arms, seeds, endpoint, decision rule or falsifiers requires an explicit recorded supersession entry with cause and a full re-run
